== Summary ==
Slip “•A Close Race” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 170, 581, 455)). Recorded with version [[A Close Race (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2): cut from that card image, with the same words; a slip that reprints a card image is recorded with that version, not as a separate version. Not a recreation.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/84/VD-L-acloserace-2024-08-02-sheet-slip.png Internet Archive item].
